description: This PHP source file defines the OrganizationAPI class, which provides API endpoints for retrieving and updating organization information within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for getting organization details, updating organization data, and validation rules, with references to external service and model classes.

classes.name: OrganizationAPI
classes.description: API class providing endpoints for retrieving and updating organization information, implementing CRUD interface with specific methods for getOne and update.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves general organization information, returning a default empty Organization object if none exists.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the getOne method, requiring an ID parameter.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates organization information based on request parameters and returns the updated data.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the update method, including required and optional parameters with length and format constraints.

methods.name: saveOrganizationInfo
methods.description: Collects request parameters, updates or creates an Organization entity, and saves it via the service.
